mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A 10% or greater monthly decline in industrial production signals a severe supply shock that increases corporate production costs and weakens demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by 10% or more from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly real GDP growth rate signals expanding economic activity that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly non-farm payrolls growth falls below 50,000, it indicates a slowing labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 50,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in housing starts signals dual deterioration in labor and housing markets, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and HOUST declines in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and HOUST declines in the prior month.
